verdict.rationale: Formant exposes multiple SDKs (Agent SDK, Cloud SDK, RealtimeSDK/toolkit) and an Admin API that let external programs ingest telemetry, issue custom commands, and teleoperate robots end-to-end, which supports the 'command a real robot via API/SDK' part of the story. However, there is no documented evidence of scoped/limited API credentials or an authentication model designed for AI agents specifically (e.g., per-agent API keys with restricted permissions) — missing for 10: scoped-credential/auth documentation for programmatic agents, explicit AI-agent identity/permission model, and independent confirmation of end-to-end agent-driven control.
